attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Consolidated and Audited Standalone Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting on November 7, 2026. The results were published in newspapers on November 8, 2026. Consolidated revenue from continuing operations was 4,177 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 8,432 crore for the half-year. Consolidated loss after tax was 50 crore for the quarter and 10 crore for the half-year. Standalone revenue from continuing operations was 1,303 crore for the quarter and 2,584 crore for the half-year. Standalone profit after tax was 122 crore for the quarter and 465 crore for the half-year. Consolidated earnings per share were negative 4.79 for the quarter and negative 5.46 for the half-year. Standalone earnings per share were 4.79 for the quarter and 18.25 for the half-year.

attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals Limited has released the audio recording of the Analysts and Investors Call regarding the Unaudited Consolidated and Audited Standalone Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on November 7, 2026. The financial results were approved by the Board of Directors during a meeting held on the same day. The audio link is available on the company website. The Company Secretary, Jeraz E. Mahernosh, has submitted this information to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited for their records.

attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "Unaudited Consolidated and Audited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals Limited filed its press release regarding unaudited consolidated and audited standalone financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 grew by 8% to ₹ 1,303 Cr, with EBITDA up 22% to ₹ 292 Cr. Consolidated revenue rose 8% to ₹ 4,177 Cr, while EBITDA stood at ₹ 381 Cr. Consolidated results were impacted by higher UK natural gas costs and the temporary suspension of Kenya operations. Net debt as on September 30, 2026, was ₹ 6,127 Cr. The company cited challenging global market conditions, including soda ash oversupply and elevated input costs, while noting positive demand outlooks in Living Essentials and cautiously positive agricultural prospects.

attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals submitted an analysts and investors presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 7, 2026. Consolidated revenue for the second quarter was 4,177 crore rupees, compared to 3,877 crore rupees in the previous year. Consolidated EBITDA stood at 381 crore rupees, down from 537 crore rupees in the prior year period. Profit after tax was a loss of 50 crore rupees, versus a profit of 219 crore rupees previously. For the half year, consolidated revenue was 8,432 crore rupees, with EBITDA at 936 crore rupees and profit after tax at 10 crore rupees. Net debt was 6,127 crore rupees as of September 2026. The presentation highlighted challenges including soda ash oversupply, weak industrial demand, and higher input costs.

attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 7, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Consolidated and Audited Standalone Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting commenced at 2.00 p.m. IST and concluded at 4.40 p.m. IST. The financial results, along with the Auditors' Report, are available on the company website. The Limited Review Report by B S R & Co. LLP states that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements in the consolidated financial results. The report notes the Group’s share of net loss after tax of Rs 3 crores and Rs 29 crores for the quarter and half-year respectively from a joint venture. It also includes the Group’s share of net profit after tax of Rs 23 crores and Rs 32 crores for the same periods from one associate and two joint ventures.
